page.overview:
What is Falathrim?

The Falathrim were the Elves living on the coasts of West Beleriand in the First Age of Middle-earth. They were also called the Coast People, Elves of the Falas and Elves of the Havens.

The Falathrim were Sindarin Elves living in the Falas of Beleriand who were persuaded to stay in Middle-earth by Ossë, but in the course of the Battles of Beleriand their ranks were swelled by Sindar and Ñoldor fleeing the armies of Morgoth. They were the first mariners and shipwrights of Middle-earth. Under their lord, Círdan, they prospered for many years, though the Falas was invaded by Orcs between the first and second battles of Beleriand, and the Falathrim were forced to withdraw to their walled havens. Throughout the First Age, the Falathrim built all the ships sailed by Men or Elves of Beleriand. They sent a force to fight with the Union of Maedhros.

When the Falas was overrun in FA 473 after the loss of the Nírnaeth Arnoediad, the surviving Falathrim removed to the Isle of Balar, where they continued to build ships and aid the Elves and Men of Arvernien. When Beleriand was destroyed after the War of Wrath, the remnant of their people and culture survived into the Second Age and Third Ages settling in Lindon and the Grey Havens.
